bayts.text: An Everlasting, Generous One, exalted above all likeness, has turned to me what is hidden from my peers.
The Benefiter (An-Nāfiʿ) has benefited me with a benefit that surpassed (all others), and I do not meet whoever refused concord.
There has appeared to me what remained hidden from others than me, and it is perpetual gladness for the one followed (the Prophet).
The Chosen has conversed intimately with me without any dispute, and wherever I stretch my hand, he provides for it.
Upon him the two peaces of an exalting Nourisher, Who never ceases (to dispense) with beneficial generosity.
The Everlasting has extended to me the reward according to His measure, from Him and from His Messenger according to his measure.
My gift from God and the Messenger has turned toward me, and I have obtained the best of requests.
The wishes have turned toward me without end, and with good pleasure what is desired is driven to me.
From God and the Messenger has come the best reward of an accepted striving.
The Sender (of the Book) has conversed intimately with me through the Book, and I have won what protects from reproach.
When I write or read a letter, I attain wishes deposited in that letter.
Mine are the glad tidings of all the letters, and they turn no harm toward me.
Mine are the benefits without troubles, in this abode, in safety, and in that abode.
Guidance, light, good pleasure and blessing came upon me suddenly in praising him who is the pride of whoever reaches him.
The Generous came to meet me in the year Aksash (1321 AH / 1903-04) with the reward of what I wrote in the year Kasash (1320 AH / 1902-03).
He surprised me by making every letter I wrote be for me with a pure reward.
I was the guest of a Generous One Who bestowed, in Shawwāl, (gifts) that put sciences and riches to shame.
On Wednesday the Most Generous led to me that beneath which lie generosity and munificence.
He Who is exalted above all likeness has come to meet me, with that through which I become absent from my peers.
Toward me He has led the reward in a mighty measure: glory be to the Lord of the Footstool (al-Kursī) and the mighty Throne!
The One (Al-Wāḥid) has conversed intimately with me among the deniers: (saying) that I have become the gladness of the praisers.
The One (Al-Aḥad) has conversed intimately with me among the idolaters, with what from Him became ruin for the doomed.
Allah — exalted! — is One; Allah is the Eternal Refuge (Aṣ-Ṣamad), Whose loftiness is manifest.
He is no begetter, nor was He begotten, nor does He need anything; whoever He guides is not blamed.
To Him is my address; and He destroys, for me, whoever denied; and there is none equal to Him (Qurʾān 112:4).
Grant me, by Your noble Countenance, my intention, O You to Whom (belongs), through the Chosen, all my being.
Drive to me, by Your noble Countenance, O Generous, in what I have intended, rewards that do not fade.
You are the One Who has fulfilled what I hope for, O You before Whom faces are humbled (Qurʾān 20:111).
Aḥmad gives thanks to his Lord, the Generous, for the gladness, and gladness is praised.
The best of the Generous, Who drives (the gifts), Who is praised, has joined my gladness to the gladness of Aḥmad.
Lost is the reward of whoever has turned toward other than my Lord and other than the Chosen, the educator.
Upon me is a covenant: to be grateful to my Lord for him who drove away the reprehensible things.
The two purest peaces of the best Lord, the Everlasting, (be) upon the Prophet, the model of the foremost.
The reward of my Lord and the reward of the Elect have led to me a good pleasure, and from it (every good) is chosen.
I am well pleased with my Lord, and my Lord is well pleased with me, without harm or illnesses.
The Giver of security (Al-Muʾmin) has honoured me with faith, when idolatry appeared in my time.
He Who never ceases to be Bestower, All-Knowing has won for me the Qurʾān and the sciences.
The Everlasting, the Generous, has extended blessings to me, as He protected me from marriage with idolatresses.
The Everlasting has turned to me clarity from turbidity, and the evils of destiny do not come toward me.
The Everlasting has extended to me a reward with gain, and has been for me with what is permitted me.
He has torn (evils) away for me, and tears nothing from me; and truly I, through Him, am a shelter and a refuge.
He leads to me, and leads nothing from me except to whom I have willed, with leave from me.
He has benefited me, and through me He benefits creation; and He has led to me, through the Prophet, the sūras.
I have triumphed through Allah's being for me and my being for Him, through him, by the standing of the best of creation.
I help every Muslim man and woman, and God has already spared me the wrongdoers.
The Generous has banished my harm and my illness, and has been for me, forever, with my aim.
My heart has become clear and my body has been healed, and I shall not cease to be clear and healed.
To me He drives my aim without illness or harm, and has already spared me wasting away.
He has made clear to me with the clarifying of Him from Whom nothing is hidden; He has bestowed on me what is most hidden.
He has turned to me the reward in His mighty measure, in what I worshipped with of well-strung pearls.
I thank Him with the gratitude of all the lovers together, and through the Prophet He has gathered my wishes for me.
He has blessed me in our much and in the little, with a blessing according to His sublime measure.
I have intended to be grateful with what He loves, for He is the Intimate, the Beloved and the most Beloved,
for my means of approach, my standing, my shield (junna): Muḥammad, the best of creation, my garden (janna).
